verdict.rationale: Versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations is a fair question for a project-management SaaS, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Basecamp offering version history, change review, or rollback for automations. Scheduled check-ins, reusable templates, and API/MCP access are adjacent features and do not count as automation version control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
